# chameleon_namespaces (Data Source)

List all Iceberg namespaces in a catalog.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "chameleon_namespaces" "all" {
  catalog = "analytics"
}

output "analytics_namespaces" {
  value = data.chameleon_namespaces.all.names
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `catalog` (String) Catalog (warehouse) name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `names` (List of String) Dot-joined namespace paths (e.g. 'analytics.raw').
